title: gtfs-jp-monitor-catalog-generations/1
description: catalog/generations/<org_id>/<feed_id>.json: every generation seen for one feed, in data-model §2 order (unorderable ones last, by uid). One file per feed keeps rewrites small. rid_observed is the latest observation and may shift; it is kept here and in run records only.

rid_observed.description: null when the generation is no longer returned by the API.

memo.description: Source text, used as a version label; not translated.

present.description: False when the API stopped returning this uid (SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE candidate); the record is kept.
